sources.entry: LinkStack - Link all your social media platforms easily accessible on one page, customizable through an intuitive, easy to use user/admin interface (alternative to Linktree and Manylink). (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP/Docker
LinkStack | Link-in-bio page, a Linktree alternative

summary.one_liner: LinkStack is a self-hostable, customizable link-in-bio page platform that positions itself as an open-source alternative to Linktree.
summary.what_it_does: LinkStack lets users publish a single page that collects all their links, such as social media profiles, in one place. It describes a user/admin interface with an Admin Panel for managing settings, themes and other users' links. Users can upload custom theme zip files through the Admin Panel, and the README points to a separate themes repository for community-made themes. The README describes a built-in updater that notifies admins of new versions, creates a backup before updating, and keeps up to two backups. It can be installed by placing the files in a web server root directory, or run as an official Docker image based on Alpine Linux with Apache2 and PHP 8.2. The README also mentions free community-hosted instances that people can register on.
use_cases: Put multiple social media links on one page for a bio
Manage link pages for multiple users or a business
Customize a link-in-bio page with themes
Run a link page on my own web hosting
how_to_run: Alternatively, download the latest release from GitHub and place the 'linkstack' folder in your website's root directory
Open the instance in a browser and complete the first setup page
notable: Self-hosted alternative to Linktree with a one-click automatic updater that creates backups
Community theme system where users can upload and share themes
Multi-user support with an Admin Panel for managing other users' links
Official Docker image based on Alpine Linux
Free community instances available for people who do not want to self-host
caveats: The README says the automatic updater may fail silently when PHP dependencies are mismatched, so manual updates may be needed
If the database is switched to MySQL, the updater backup does not include the database
Relies on a web server and PHP environment, so it is not a standalone app
keywords: share all my links in one place
